newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks firm but off session highs.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks firm but off session highs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were holding firm early Tuesday afternoon, having recovered some ground after Monday's sharp sell-off, though share prices had drifted off their session peaks.
Still, the stock market, which sank the previous day amid concerns that Japan might soon sell U.S. government bonds, was still unsettled by Monday's big drop, traders said.
The Dow industrials were up around 32 points at 7636, below intraday highs of 7686. Nasdaq was up four at 1439.
Investor concerns eased somewhat after Japan's Ministry of Finance said remarks by Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto regarding U.S. goverment bonds were not properly reported.
